title: CompTIA Security+ Study Bank
summary: Comprehensive SY0-701 practice bank across all five official domains with structured objectives, difficulty tiers, and topic tags.

domains.title: General Security Concepts
domains.description: Security controls, CIA triad, AAA, Zero Trust, cryptography, hashing, and PKI.

domains.title: Threats, Vulnerabilities, and Mitigations
domains.description: Threat actors, attack vectors, malware, social engineering, application/network attacks, and vulnerability management.

domains.title: Security Architecture
domains.description: Cloud & hybrid models, virtualization, IoT/ICS resilience, network segmentation, firewalls, IDS/IPS, and secure protocols.

domains.title: Security Operations
domains.description: Identity & access management (IAM/MFA/SSO/PAM), SIEM/SOAR monitoring, endpoint hardening, and NIST incident response.

domains.title: Security Program Management and Oversight
domains.description: Security governance policies, quantitative/qualitative risk management, third-party risk, GDPR/HIPAA/PCI-DSS compliance, and audits.
